name: Spring Creek Ranch
positioning: Western-style ranch resort on a wildlife sanctuary atop East Gros Ventre Butte above the town of Jackson, with views of the Teton Range
best_for: Travelers who want Teton views and protected open space for riding, hiking and cross-country skiing
Groups wanting four-bedroom Mountain Villas with full kitchens

facts.text: Spring Creek Ranch is located on a wildlife sanctuary above the town of Jackson.
The ranch sits atop East Gros Ventre Butte.
The protected open space around the ranch is home to more than 100 species of birds and wildlife.
The ranch's location gives it views of the Teton Mountain Range, including the Grand Teton.
Guests can choose from Inn Rooms, Studios, Suites, Townhomes or Mountain Villas.
The ranch has a seasonal outdoor heated pool.
The Wilderness Adventure Spa has a fitness room, an indoor hot tub and an outdoor saltwater hot tub.
The open space of East Gros Ventre Butte is available to guests for horseback riding, hiking and cross-country skiing.
In winter, the ranch's resident naturalist leads snowshoe excursions to find wild animal tracks.
Guests can roast marshmallows over an open fire pit and watch the sunset over the Tetons.
A shuttle service runs to and from the town of Jackson, about 10 minutes away.
During the ski season, the shuttle also serves Jackson Hole Mountain Resort.

highlights.text: Guests can have a custom massage in an authentic teepee.
What was once open range is now protected in perpetuity as nearly 1,000 acres of open space.
The ranch has its own Equestrian Center, along with salt water hot tubs.
Every Mountain Villa has four bedrooms, four baths, a full kitchen, dining room, living room and fireplaces throughout.
The Wilderness Adventure Spa is a cell-phone-free environment.

considerations.text: The units do not have air conditioning; the ranch relies on cool mountain breezes instead.
Pets are not allowed, because the ranch sits on a wildlife refuge.
A resort fee is added to all visitor stays.
